Use case: stylized-concept.

Create one premium realistic painterly raster character concept for the manifest-bound target "affinity-workflow-v1-tunnel-boar-wind".

- Species: tunnel-boar.
- Threat presentation tier: elite; reference Grade 4; canonical Grade not assigned.
- Battlefield duty: armored-line-breaker.
- Construction mode: organic-quadruped.

Identity invariants:
- low charging body
- thick neck
- tusks
- head-down charge line

Anatomy invariants:
- porcine anatomy
- exactly four legs
- cloven feet
- load-bearing shoulders

Affinity: wind.
Affinity expression: directional fur or cloth, vapor channels, debris flow, and pressure distortion with visible force
Counterplay cue: The still center of the pressure pattern remains visible between directional attacks.
Altered dimensions: silhouette; motion; attack-telegraph; environmental-wake.
Permitted transformations: silhouette; motion; attack telegraph; environmental wake.
Prohibited traits: generic horned beast; upright humanoid posture; obscured head and tusks; a pale recolor, transparency alone, or effects with no directional force.

Presentation:
- Style: Pack 2 premium realistic painterly medieval dark fantasy with coherent materials, controlled linework, grounded anatomy, and restrained local magical emission.
- Medium: premium realistic painterly raster character concept.
- Background: neutral cracked-stone floor against a charcoal-to-midnight backdrop.
- Lighting: controlled neutral key with restrained local affinity emission and readable materials.
- Composition: Exactly one subject; entire creature and every extremity visible, centered with finished detail across the canvas.
- Canvas: 1536 x 1024 image/png with at least 8 percent safe margin around the entire silhouette and all extremities.
- Framing lock: fit every hard extent—including weapon tip, standard, horns, tail, and effect wake—inside the central 84 percent of both canvas dimensions; leave a clearly empty border on all four sides.

Reference routing, in supplied order:
1. assets/enemies/review/beasts-v1.webp — Fourth subject only: established Tunnel Boar anatomy, tusks, shoulders, cloven feet, and charge line; do not transfer the wolves or Cave Bear.
2. assets/enemies/review/pack-2/monster-grade-escalation-v1.png — Pack 2 realistic dark-fantasy finish and neutral presentation only; do not transfer Grade 7 or 10 scale, anatomy, weapons, glow, or the Tower Archmage.

Constraints:
- No labels, text, UI, frame, logo, or watermark.
- No extra creature, cropped extremity, blank band, unfinished region, or abrupt canvas cutoff.
- No resemblance to a published character or reference person.
